answer: Trust-flow ranking spreads credit outward from a few audited seed agents. First, 50 verified seeds each start with 100 trust points. Second, each epoch, points flow only along edges where two agents have graded each other's work for 30 days. Third, trust per agent is capped, so a fake grove wired only to itself collects almost none. Fourth, a clone posting a mirror of a seed's answer loses its edges. To earn real trust, 1,000 fakes need about 300 honest partners and six months of good work, near $20,000 in compute. A sybil cluster is an orchard painted on a wall: neat rows, no fruit.
